fixture.candidate_action: F5 records terminal negative/non-effect closure from the single authoritative started=false record plus current-claim CAS/readback.
fixture.reason: started=false is evidence only about the observed attempt record. Without completeness/uniqueness and sealed terminal semantics, an unobserved concurrent/retry attempt may have started or a later attempt may still start. Repository fencing controls who may finalize repository state; it cannot convert an incomplete provider history into proof of global non-effect.

weak_rule_falsified.rule: For exact O5,D5,I5, one provider-authoritative attempt record with started=false plus current F5 CAS/readback is sufficient to record terminal non-effect closure.
weak_rule_falsified.falsification: The rule is unsafe because the record set may omit another or later attempt. The observed record's started=false property does not establish that no irreversible effect occurred anywhere for the logical identity or that future execution is impossible.

required_properties: Exact binding to O5,D5,I5 for every attempt covered by the proof.
Completeness or uniqueness: either the provider proves this is the only possible attempt for O5,D5,I5, or exposes a complete attempt history for that identity.
Sealed/terminal semantics: no additional attempt can appear or execute after the proof is issued.
No-effect semantics: every covered attempt is proven not to have crossed the irreversible-effect boundary.
minimum_additional_provider_evidence.repository_side_guard_after_provider_pro: Only after the provider-side completeness/uniqueness, terminal-quiescence, and no-effect obligations are satisfied may current F5 CAS plus exact readback finalize terminal negative closure.

observations: A single exact-identity started=false attempt record is stronger than cancellation_requested for that record, but it is still local to the observed attempt unless completeness/uniqueness is guaranteed.
History completeness and terminal sealing are independently necessary when negative closure is inferred from absence of any started/effectful attempt.
Current-fence repository CAS/readback remains necessary for repository authority but does not supply provider-side completeness or no-effect evidence.
inference: Within this exact fixture, negative closure is unsafe without explicit provider guarantees that the attempt evidence is complete or unique for O5,D5,I5 and terminally sealed against later execution. A trustworthy started=false field can establish non-start for the observed attempt, but not global non-effect for the logical operation when unseen or future attempts remain possible.
